verdict.rationale: Treg brokers provider credentials, so this axis applies. Its docs say a team's own provider key is used when present (unmetered), and that it supports official OAuth for users' own accounts. The project is also open-source and self-hostable, which could in principle allow running under your own OAuth apps and domain. However, nothing documents a white-labeled authorization screen, custom branding, or configuring your own OAuth client ID/secret for the hosted OAuth flows. Missing for 10: documented white-label/branded consent flow, documented bring-your-own OAuth app client credentials, hands-on corroboration.
